sentences.text: Some cheese has holes in it.
Big round holes, inside the cheese.
Most cheese does not.
So where do they come from?
They are made of gas.
Very small animals make the gas.
Not animals. Bacteria.
Cheese is full of them.
This is normal and it is good.
Bacteria are what make milk into cheese.
sentences.translationRu: Именно бактерии превращают молоко в сыр.

sentences.text: One kind of bacteria eats a sour acid.
And it makes a gas while it eats.
The cheese is soft and thick.
The gas cannot get out.
So it stays inside and makes a ball.
sentences.translationRu: Он остаётся внутри и образует шарик.

sentences.text: The ball grows for weeks.
Then the cheese is cut open.
And there is a hole.
Cheese makers call them eyes.
They can make them bigger or smaller.
sentences.translationRu: Их можно сделать больше или меньше.

sentences.text: A warm room means a bigger hole.
A cold room means a small one.
So the holes are a choice.
There is a strange new part to this story.
sentences.translationRu: В этой истории есть новая странная часть.

sentences.text: About twenty years ago
the holes started to disappear.
Nobody had changed the recipe.
Cheese makers were worried.
Scientists looked for years.
Then they found the answer.
It was the milk buckets.
sentences.translationRu: Дело было в вёдрах для молока.

sentences.text: Old buckets were open, and made of metal.
sentences.translationRu: Старые вёдра были открытыми и металлическими.

sentences.text: Tiny bits of hay fell into the milk.
sentences.translationRu: В молоко попадали крошечные кусочки сена.

sentences.text: The gas needs something to start on.
The hay was that something.
New machines are closed and very clean.
sentences.translationRu: Новые машины закрыты и очень чисты.

sentences.text: No hay. No holes.
So now some makers add a little hay dust.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому теперь кто-то добавляет немного сенной пыли.

sentences.text: On purpose, to make the cheese dirtier.
A zip is on your bag and your coat.
sentences.translationRu: Молния есть на сумке и на куртке.

sentences.text: You pull it and it closes.
You pull it back and it opens.
Most people never look at it.
sentences.translationRu: Большинство на неё даже не смотрит.

sentences.text: Look at it now.
There are two rows of small teeth.
Look closely at one tooth.
It has a small bump on the top.
And a small hole under it.
Every tooth is the same.
The bump of one tooth
goes into the hole of another.
That is the whole idea.
Now look at the thing you pull.
It is called the slider.
Inside it there is a small wedge.
Like the front of a boat.
When you pull the slider down,
the wedge pushes the two rows apart.
The teeth come out of each other.
The zip is open.
When you pull it up,
the wedge is behind the teeth.
Two narrow paths bring them together.
sentences.translationRu: Два узких канала сводят их вместе.

sentences.text: At an angle, one at a time.
Each tooth is pressed into the one below.
So a zip is not a door.
It is a small machine that builds a wall.
And takes it apart again.
This is also why a zip breaks.
If one tooth is bent, it will not fit.
sentences.translationRu: Если один зубчик погнут, он не встанет.

sentences.text: The wall has a bad brick in it.
And it opens behind the slider.
The first zip was made over a hundred years ago.
sentences.translationRu: Первую молнию сделали больше ста лет назад.

sentences.text: Nobody wanted it for many years.
sentences.translationRu: Много лет она никому не была нужна.

sentences.text: It was used on boots and on bags.
sentences.translationRu: Её ставили на ботинки и сумки.

sentences.text: Clothes came much later.
People thought it was strange.
Humans lost almost all their hair.
Our bodies are nearly bare.
But two things stayed.
The hair on the head.
And a small line above each eye.
sentences.translationRu: И маленькая полоска над каждым глазом.

sentences.text: Eyebrows are strange when you think about it.
Why keep those, and lose the rest?
sentences.translationRu: Зачем сохранить их и потерять остальное?

sentences.text: The first answer is water.
Sweat runs down your forehead.
Rain runs down too.
Salt water in the eye hurts.
And you cannot see for a moment.
sentences.translationRu: И на мгновение ты не видишь.

sentences.text: An eyebrow is curved for a reason.
It sends the water to the side.
Past the eye, down the face.
The hairs point outwards to help.
So they are a small roof.
But that is not the main reason.
sentences.translationRu: Но главная причина не в этом.

sentences.text: Scientists studied very old skulls.
Our old relatives had a heavy brow.
sentences.translationRu: У наших древних родственников был тяжёлый надбровный валик.

sentences.text: A thick bone line above the eyes.
It could not move at all.
Our brow is thin and flat.
sentences.translationRu: Наша надбровная область тонкая и плоская.

sentences.text: Which lets the eyebrow move a lot.
And that is the point.
Raise one eyebrow.
You have just asked a question.
Raise both quickly.
You have said hello, or I am surprised.
Pull them together and down.
You are angry, or you are thinking hard.
Nobody teaches this.
It is the same in every country.
sentences.translationRu: И это одинаково в любой стране.

sentences.text: People can read a face without a word.
Mostly from the eyes and the eyebrows.
sentences.translationRu: В основном по глазам и бровям.

sentences.text: Take the eyebrows out of a photo
and people cannot say who it is.
sentences.translationRu: и люди не смогут сказать, кто это.

sentences.text: This has been tested.
It works less well without the eyes removed.
Eyebrows matter more than we think.
sentences.translationRu: Брови значат больше, чем мы думаем.

title: The colours in autumn leaves were there all summer

sentences.text: In autumn, leaves turn yellow and red.
The usual explanation is that they change.
Half of that is wrong.
The yellow was there the whole time.
A leaf contains several colours at once.
Green is by far the strongest.
It is the substance that catches sunlight.
The tree uses it to make sugar.
sentences.translationRu: Дерево использует его, чтобы делать сахар.

sentences.text: It is also expensive to keep.
It breaks down in light and must be rebuilt.
sentences.translationRu: Оно распадается на свету, и его надо чинить.

sentences.text: All summer the tree keeps rebuilding it.
In autumn the days get shorter.
Soon there will not be enough light
to pay for the leaf at all.
So the tree begins to close it down.
It stops rebuilding the green.
The green fades in a few weeks.
And the yellow underneath appears.
sentences.translationRu: И проступает жёлтый, который был под ним.

sentences.text: It did not arrive. It was uncovered.
Red is a different story.
Red is made fresh, in autumn.
Which is odd, if the leaf is dying.
Why spend energy on a leaf you are throwing away?
sentences.translationRu: Зачем тратить силы на лист, который выбрасываешь?

sentences.text: Before a leaf falls, the tree empties it.
It pulls back the useful parts.
Mostly nitrogen, which is hard to find.
sentences.translationRu: В основном азот, который трудно достать.

sentences.text: That takes several weeks.
And during those weeks the leaf is fragile.
sentences.translationRu: И все эти недели лист уязвим.

sentences.text: The leading idea is that red is protection.
It works like a filter against bright light.
sentences.translationRu: Он работает как фильтр от яркого света.

sentences.text: Cold sunny days damage a weakened leaf.
sentences.translationRu: Холодные солнечные дни вредят ослабевшему листу.

sentences.text: Red buys it time to finish emptying.
sentences.translationRu: Красный выигрывает время, чтобы дочистить лист.

sentences.text: This fits what people see.
The best red autumns follow cold bright weeks.
sentences.translationRu: Самая яркая осень бывает после холодных ясных недель.

sentences.text: Warm cloudy autumns are mostly yellow.
sentences.translationRu: Тёплая пасмурная осень — в основном жёлтая.

sentences.text: Then the tree cuts the leaf loose.
It grows a thin layer at the stem.
The leaf is not torn off by wind.
It is released, and the wind carries it.

title: A piano cannot be tuned correctly

sentences.text: A piano has eighty-eight keys.
Behind them are around two hundred strings.
Each one pulled to enormous tension.
Together they pull with about twenty tonnes.
sentences.translationRu: Вместе они тянут примерно на двадцать тонн.

sentences.text: A tuner adjusts every one of them by hand.
It takes around two hours.
Here is the part almost nobody knows.
sentences.translationRu: И вот что почти никто не знает.

sentences.text: A piano cannot be tuned correctly.
Not because tuners are imperfect.
Because the mathematics does not allow it.
sentences.translationRu: А потому, что математика не позволяет.

sentences.text: Musical notes are ratios.
Double a frequency and you get the same note
sentences.translationRu: Удвой частоту — получишь ту же ноту,

sentences.text: one octave higher.
Other intervals are other simple ratios.
Three to two. Four to three.
sentences.translationRu: Три к двум. Четыре к трём.

sentences.text: These sound clean because the waves line up.
sentences.translationRu: Они звучат чисто, потому что волны совпадают.

sentences.text: Now go up in perfect steps of three to two.
sentences.translationRu: Теперь иди вверх идеальными шагами три к двум.

sentences.text: Twelve times, and you should land
sentences.translationRu: Двенадцать раз — и ты должен прийти

sentences.text: on the same note, seven octaves higher.
sentences.translationRu: к той же ноте, на семь октав выше.

sentences.text: You do not.
You land slightly above it.
The gap is small and it is real.
No amount of care removes it.
It is a fact about numbers.
So every piano is a compromise.
The error is shared out across all the keys.
Every interval is slightly wrong.
None of them is wrong enough to hurt.
sentences.translationRu: И ни один не настолько, чтобы резать слух.

sentences.text: That decision is why a piano can change key.
sentences.translationRu: Благодаря этому решению пианино может менять тональность.

sentences.text: An instrument tuned perfectly for one key
sentences.translationRu: Инструмент, идеально настроенный под одну тональность,

sentences.text: sounds terrible in a distant one.
There is more that the numbers do not cover.
sentences.translationRu: Есть и то, чего числа не покрывают.

sentences.text: A real string is not perfectly flexible.
Its higher tones sit slightly sharp.
So tuners stretch the tuning outwards.
The top of the piano is tuned high.
The bottom is tuned low.
By an amount that is judged, not calculated.
sentences.translationRu: На величину, которую оценивают на слух, а не считают.

sentences.text: Which is why the job has not been automated away.
Machines can measure a frequency perfectly.
They cannot decide how wrong to be.
sentences.translationRu: Они не могут решить, насколько ошибиться.

title: The best players rarely become the best coaches

sentences.text: Look at a list of the most successful coaches
sentences.translationRu: Посмотри на список самых успешных тренеров

sentences.text: in almost any team sport.
Very few of them were great players.
sentences.translationRu: Великих игроков среди них очень мало.

sentences.text: Many had modest careers.
Several barely played at the top level at all.
sentences.translationRu: Некоторые почти не играли на высшем уровне.

sentences.text: The pattern is consistent enough
that it needs an explanation.
The easy one is time.
A great player retires late and rich.
sentences.translationRu: Великий игрок уходит поздно и богатым.

sentences.text: A modest one stops early and needs work.
sentences.translationRu: Скромный заканчивает рано и нуждается в работе.

sentences.text: So he starts coaching younger.
That is true and it is not enough.
The deeper reason is about knowledge.
An expert's skill becomes automatic.
That is what expertise is.
The steps sink below awareness
so the whole action can run at speed.
Which is exactly what makes it hard to teach.
sentences.translationRu: И именно это мешает его преподавать.

sentences.text: Researchers call it the expert blind spot.
sentences.translationRu: Исследователи зовут это слепым пятном эксперта.

sentences.text: Ask a great striker how he finished.
sentences.translationRu: Спроси великого нападающего, как он забил.

sentences.text: He will describe what he saw and felt.
sentences.translationRu: Он опишет, что видел и чувствовал.

sentences.text: Not the decision, because there was none.
It had stopped being a decision years earlier.
sentences.translationRu: Оно перестало быть решением годами раньше.

sentences.text: Meanwhile a player who was never quite good enough
sentences.translationRu: А игрок, которому всегда чуть не хватало,

sentences.text: spent his career doing it consciously.
Breaking it down. Watching others.
sentences.translationRu: Разбирая на части. Наблюдая за другими.

sentences.text: Finding the cheapest way to get an advantage.
sentences.translationRu: Выискивая самый дешёвый способ получить преимущество.

sentences.text: He built an explicit model
because he could not rely on an instinct.
sentences.translationRu: потому что не мог положиться на инстинкт.

sentences.text: An explicit model can be handed to somebody.
An instinct cannot.
There is a second problem, about patience.
sentences.translationRu: Есть и вторая проблема — про терпение.

sentences.text: A coach spends most of his time
with players who are worse than he was.
sentences.translationRu: проводит с игроками, которые хуже, чем был он.

sentences.text: Somebody who found it easy
often cannot see why it is hard.
sentences.translationRu: часто не видно, почему это трудно.

sentences.text: And impatience is felt long before it is spoken.
sentences.translationRu: А нетерпение чувствуется задолго до того, как прозвучит.

sentences.text: None of this says a great player cannot coach.
sentences.translationRu: Ничто из этого не говорит, что великий игрок не может тренировать.

sentences.text: Some have, and brilliantly.
It says the two jobs share a name
sentences.translationRu: Это говорит, что у двух профессий общее поле,

sentences.text: and almost nothing else.
Being able to do a thing
and being able to cause it in somebody else
sentences.translationRu: и умение вызвать это в другом

sentences.text: are separate skills, and only one is famous.
sentences.translationRu: — разные навыки, и знаменит только один.

title: A creature with no brain that solves mazes

sentences.text: Slime mould is not a plant or an animal.
sentences.translationRu: Слизевик — не растение и не животное.

sentences.text: It is a single cell, spread out.
sentences.translationRu: Это одна клетка, растёкшаяся по поверхности.

sentences.text: Sometimes across a whole square metre.
With many nuclei and no divisions between them.
sentences.translationRu: С множеством ядер и без перегородок между ними.

sentences.text: It has no brain, no nerves and no eyes.
sentences.translationRu: У него нет мозга, нервов и глаз.

sentences.text: It moves at about a centimetre an hour.
sentences.translationRu: Он движется примерно на сантиметр в час.

sentences.text: It also solves problems
that we assume require a mind.
sentences.translationRu: которые, как мы полагаем, требуют разума.

sentences.text: Put it at the entrance of a maze.
sentences.translationRu: Помести его у входа в лабиринт.

sentences.text: Put food at the exit.
At first it fills the maze completely.
Every corridor, every dead end.
Then it begins to withdraw.
It pulls back from the dead ends
and thickens along the shortest route.
Within hours only that route is left.
sentences.translationRu: За часы остаётся только этот путь.

sentences.text: The mechanism is chemical and local.
Where food is found, a signal strengthens the tube.
sentences.translationRu: Там, где найдена еда, сигнал укрепляет трубку.

sentences.text: A thicker tube carries more flow.
sentences.translationRu: Более толстая трубка несёт больший поток.

sentences.text: More flow thickens it further.
sentences.translationRu: Больший поток утолщает её ещё сильнее.

sentences.text: Tubes carrying nothing are reabsorbed.
sentences.translationRu: Трубки, которые ничего не несут, рассасываются.

sentences.text: No part of it knows the answer.
sentences.translationRu: Ни одна часть не знает ответа.

sentences.text: The answer is what survives the process.
sentences.translationRu: Ответ — это то, что пережило процесс.

sentences.text: The famous experiment went further.
Researchers laid out oat flakes
in the pattern of cities around Tokyo.
They used light to represent mountains,
because the organism avoids it.
Then they let it grow.
The network it produced
closely resembled the actual rail network.
sentences.translationRu: оказалась близка к настоящей железнодорожной сети.

sentences.text: Which took engineers decades and committees.
sentences.translationRu: На неё у инженеров ушли десятилетия и комиссии.

sentences.text: It was comparable on cost, on length,
sentences.translationRu: Она сопоставима по стоимости, по длине

sentences.text: and on what happens when a link is cut.
sentences.translationRu: и по тому, что бывает при разрыве связи.

sentences.text: The conclusion people draw is usually too large.
sentences.translationRu: Вывод, который отсюда делают, обычно слишком велик.

sentences.text: This is not intelligence in a jar.
It is a demonstration of something narrower.
That certain problems have physical solutions.
sentences.translationRu: Что у некоторых задач есть физические решения.

sentences.text: Efficient networks can be grown
rather than designed, by a system
that reinforces what works and drops what does not.
sentences.translationRu: которая усиливает работающее и сбрасывает лишнее.

sentences.text: Which is worth remembering
whenever a plan requires an overview
that nobody actually has.
sentences.translationRu: которого на самом деле ни у кого нет.
